import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Convert Quantity to numeric (coerce errors to NaN) and drop rows with invalid Quantity
    df['Quantity'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Quantity'], errors='coerce')
    df = df.dropna(subset=['Quantity'])
    # Keep only positive quantities (as per rule)
    df = df[df['Quantity'] > 0]
    # Convert Price to numeric, stripping $ and commas if present
    if df['Price'].str.startswith('$').any():
        df['Price'] = df['Price'].str.replace('$', '', regex=False)
    df['Price'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Price'], errors='coerce')
    df = df.dropna(subset=['Price'])
    # Standardize Region labels (title case) and drop rows with missing Region after cleaning
    df['Region'] = df['Region'].str.title()
    df = df.dropna(subset=['Region'])
    return df

def answer(df):
    # Group by Region and sum Quantity (units sold)
    result = df.groupby('Region')['Quantity'].sum().to_dict()
    return result
